summary: Forest Service lookout on Termination Point, built in the 1930s and reported dismantled by 1953; a summit footing and some wood remain in photos.

facts.design: Cabin per the register; a 1937 photo survey called the structure a lookout tower
facts.status_note: Cabin abandoned and gone; a 1953 revisit found the lookout dismantled; a footing and some wood are in photographs; no source describes a standing structure

access.note: No closure appears in the sources read; the route is a rough forest road and a trail that is hard to make out

visit.trail_note: Willhite gives under a quarter mile from the end of roads; the 2022 WTA trip report describes a half-mile uphill trail that is hard to make out and crossed by game trails

events.note: Decade only: the register gives the 1930's and firelookout.com says 1930s; WTA quotes Kreske's book as 1930s
A lookout is labeled on the 1932 Columbia National Forest map
Panoramic photo survey taken August 26, 1937, 25 feet above ground; a 1937 recreation map also shows a structure
A USGS party said there was a Forest Service lookout called Termination Point
Revisit found the Forest Service lookout had been dismantled

corrections.proposed: 1930s (decade only; no single year is given)
corrections.why: The register gives the Built field as 1930's, not a single year

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com call the structure a cabin; Willhite says a 1937 photo survey called it a lookout tower. The sources do not settle which it was.
Willhite gives under a quarter mile from the end of roads; the 2022 trip report describes a half-mile uphill trail from a parking area.

sources.title: Termination Point Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: Brief's fflos_registered date (2020-04-08) could not be confirmed in the cached FFLOS text (the date field came back blank), so no registration event is recorded. Brief's access 'unknown' is now public with no closure in the sources read. Staffing and fire history: nothing in the sources read, so none recorded. Walking distance conflicts between Willhite and WTA are noted in resolved_conflicts. Kreske's book is cited only second-hand through the WTA trip report.
